content.short: XDAO is a multichain no-code DAO creation platform enabling communities to form and govern decentralized organizations on Mantle without coding.
content.description: XDAO is a no-code platform for creating and managing Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) across multiple blockchain networks, allowing teams to launch a DAO with customizable governance parameters, treasury management, and voting mechanisms without any programming knowledge. The platform supports multi-signature wallets, on-chain proposal systems, and token distribution tools. Deployed on Mantle, XDAO makes decentralized governance accessible to any community in the ecosystem.
